rows.obligation: Property and Stock Agents Act 2002 (NSW) s 55: signed agency agreement, copy served in 48h
rows.meaning: A register can show which management agreements are unsigned, missing prescribed terms or lacking a served copy. It can't decide whether one is valid or whether commission is payable.
rows.design: Signature, date and service fields link to their page, and gaps go to the licensee in charge.
rows.evidence: An agreement register with page-linked fields, and an exception list

rows.obligation: Estate Agents (General, Accounts and Audit) Regs 2018 (Vic) rr 29–30: trust change log
rows.meaning: If you keep trust records in a computerised accounting system, it must log before-and-after detail when principal, transaction or ledger details change, and must not let a recorded transaction change except by a separate one.
rows.design: We stay read-only on the trust ledger: no entries, edits or deletions.
rows.evidence: A data note showing read-only access on each system, and a log of every read

rows.obligation: Agents Financial Administration Act 2014 (Qld) ss 35–36: annual audit, 2 unannounced checks
rows.meaning: If you were an agent for the whole audit period, your auditor must make 2 unannounced examinations of your trust accounts during it, besides the annual audit.
rows.design: The Trust Audit Prep Pack re-runs from read-only ledger exports and leaves every judgement to your auditor.
rows.evidence: A re-runnable disbursement sample with each invoice and owner approval linked

rows.obligation: Residential Tenancies and Rooming Accommodation Act 2008 (Qld) s 136AA: bond evidence
rows.meaning: When you claim on a bond, or dispute a tenant's refund application, you must give the tenant supporting evidence within 14 days of the application or request, unless you can't reach them after reasonable efforts.
rows.design: The Bond Claim Evidence Pack links each claimed item to its condition-report page and photo, and drafts the bundle for a property manager to check and send.
rows.evidence: A draft evidence bundle, and a list of claimed items with no support

rows.obligation: Residential Tenancies Act 1997 (Vic) ss 505BB–505BC: protect, then destroy renter data
rows.meaning: You must take reasonable steps to protect renter information from misuse, loss and unauthorised access or disclosure, and destroy or permanently de-identify it within 3 years after the agreement ends (for unsuccessful applicants, 30 days after the property is let, or 6 months with written consent). It counts as held wherever the document sits, in or outside Victoria.
rows.design: We map every place renter information will land, including any model or index provider, and apply the same destruction dates to every copy.
rows.evidence: A data-flow map with the destruction date applied at each location
